shellCommands.command: /bin/bash -lc "ls -la && rg --files -g '"'!node_modules'"' -g '"'!package-lock.json'"' -g '"'!yarn.lock'"' -g '"'!pnpm-lock.yaml'"' && cat package.json && cat src/App.tsx && cat src/main.tsx"
/bin/bash -lc "rg --files node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit | rg '/(Toaster|Button|Icon|Switch)/|toaster' | head -60 && cat tsconfig.json && cat index.html && git status --short"
/bin/bash -lc "sed -n '1,150p' src/App.tsx && sed -n '1,65p' src/App.css && cat .gitignore && cat index.html"
/bin/bash -lc 'which apt-get; which sudo; id; cat /etc/os-release; ls /usr/lib/aarch64-linux-gnu | head'
/bin/bash -lc "ldd /home/node/.cache/ms-playwright/chromium-1248/chrome-linux-arm64/chrome | rg 'not found'; ls /var/lib/apt/lists | head; which curl; which dpkg-deb"

/bin/bash -lc 'mkdir -p /tmp/ping-browser/debs /tmp/ping-browser/libs && cd /tmp/ping-browser/debs && apt-get download libglib2.0-0 libnspr4 libnss3 libatk1.0-0 libatk-bridge2.0-0 libdbus-1-3 libcups2 libxkbcommon0 libasound2 libgbm1 libcairo2 libpango-1.0-0 libxcomposite1 libxdamage1 libxfixes3 libxrandr2 libatspi2.0-0 libdrm2 libpixman-1-0 libthai0 libdatrie1 libfribidi0 libgraphite2-3 libharfbuzz0b libwayland-server0 libavahi-client3 libavahi-common3 && for archive in *.deb; do dpkg-deb -x "$archive" /tmp/ping-browser/libs; done'

/bin/bash -lc 'cd /tmp/ping-browser/debs && apt-get download libfontconfig1 libfreetype6 libpng16-16 libxcb-shm0 libxcb-render0 libxrender1 libxi6 && for archive in *.deb; do dpkg-deb -x "$archive" /tmp/ping-browser/libs; done'
/bin/bash -lc 'cd /tmp/ping-browser/debs && apt-get download libsqlite3-0 fontconfig-config fonts-dejavu-core && for archive in *.deb; do dpkg-deb -x "$archive" /tmp/ping-browser/libs; done'

/bin/bash -lc "node -e \"const fs=require('node:fs');const p='/tmp/ping-browser/check.mjs';fs.writeFileSync(p,fs.readFileSync(p,'utf8').replace(\\\"name: 'Хорошие новости. Без лишнего шума.'\\\",\\\"name: /Хорошие новости/\\\"));\""
